tasks.label: Live Preview: Digitizer (macOS)
tasks.command: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -f avfoundation -pixel_format uyvy422 -framerate 60 -i "USB3 Video:none" -an -f mpegts "udp://127.0.0.1:12345" & sleep 0.5 && mpv "udp://127.0.0.1:12345" --audio-device="avfoundation/USB3 Video" --profile=low-latency --autofit=480x270 --title="Digitizer Preview" --ontop --mute=yes >/dev/null 2>&1; kill $!

tasks.label: Live Preview: Digitizer (Linux)
tasks.command: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -f v4l2 -input_format mjpeg -i $(v4l2-ctl --list-devices | grep -A 1 "USB3 Video" | tail -n 1 | xargs) -an -f mpegts "udp://127.0.0.1:12345" & sleep 0.5 && mpv "udp://127.0.0.1:12345" --audio-device="alsa/default" --profile=low-latency --autofit=480x270 --title="Digitizer Preview" --ontop --mute=yes >/dev/null 2>&1; kill $!
